teamCommandHelp: USAGE
chemx team <status|task|lock|unlock|feed|post|inbox|dm|tokens|benchmark> [options]
aliases: swarm, feed, tokens, telemetry, benchmark, ablation, memory
Multi-agent coordination layer backed by SQLite (.chemx/index.db).

Task queues, status transitions, AST verification on completion and file locks. `tokens` and `benchmark` are team subcommands. Run `chemx team task --help` for task detail. An option with a value takes it after a space or an equals sign (`--prio 2`, `--prio=2`).
FLAGS
--as=<@handle>            Agent identity handle (e.g. @claude)
--target=<path>           Target file path for task AST verification
--no-target-confirm       Complete a task that has no target file without verification
--force, -f               Force complete task even if hazards remain
--tokens=<N>              Prompt tokens consumed by task
--cost=<USD>              Estimated dollar cost for task
--epic=<id>               tokens: tokens, cost and wall time over an epic's children, recursively (see docs/team-tokens.md)
--from=<@handle>          feed: only events authored by this handle
--type=<lock|status|post|task>feed: an event-type group (or an exact event type, comma-separated)
--since=<id>              feed: only events after this event id
--full                    feed: whole messages (default: the newest 20, one line each)
--brief                   task show: header facts and only the comments after the description
--mine                    status: only your open tasks, leases and own events
--blockers                status: also list the blocked tasks
--json                    Output data as JSON
Only chemx's own flags are checked, and only for typos close to a known flag; any other flag is passed on unchecked (owns its subcommand parsers).
--root=<dir> (or CHEMX_PROJECT_ROOT) runs this in another project from any cwd; relative paths then mean that project's.
EXAMPLES
chemx team task list
chemx team task add "Implement dark mode toggle" --prio=1
chemx team task claim 1 --as=@coder
chemx team task show 12 --brief
chemx team lock src/a.js src/b.js --as=@coder
chemx team task done 1 --as=@coder
chemx team feed --from=@coder --type=lock
chemx team status --mine
